title: About Austin Wade Smith
paragraphs: Austin Wade Smith (they/them) is a designer and developer focusing on the interface between ecological and living systems and the codes that structure social life through law, economics, and technology. They are trained as a plant ecologist and architect with a focus on applied computation (MIT, 2015). They are the Executive Director of Regen Foundation and cofounder of River Computer. They are the lead author of Ecological Institutions: Law, Economics, and Technology in a More-Than-Human World (forthcoming, 2026). Through writing and collaboration in context, they prototype novel institutions and models for planetary resilience, leveraging decentralized protocols for addressing, governance, and perception across digital and planetary commons. They are the primary architect of the **Claims Engine**, a modular oracle and attestation framework for ecological accounting and contracting, supported by grants from the Ethereum Foundation and Celo, and cofounder of the **Institutional Development Kit (IDK)**, a set of facilitation tools for designing ecological institutions and living covenants. Through their practice, they have developed and advised on eco-social governance systems across Ecuador, Kenya, Uganda, Aotearoa New Zealand, and the United States, collaborating with Indigenous communities, technologists, NGOs, and public institutions to address climate risk, support habitat regeneration, and strengthen the agency of ecosystem stewards.
